paragraphs: Abba Chilkiyah, grandson of Choni the Circle-Drawer: Taanit 23a; see there for his deeds, and there for his burial. Gilgulei Neshamot, letter alef, writes: he is Manoach, peace be upon him, who walked behind his wife. Abba Chilkiyah wished to show that what he did then was intentional and for a good purpose, when the sages came to him about rain: Taanit, there. He also showed his wife's piety, for her cloud preceded his cloud. She is Tzelelponit: the angel came to her before coming to her husband Manoach. She had another merit: Chilkiyah's wife prayed that the violent men would repent, whereas he prayed that they would die. End of quotation. On this subject, see VaYakhel Moshe, folios 44, 45, 46.
